annotations.title: Draft an llms.txt for a site

description: Returns a draft llms file built from the domain's homepage and up to 25 pages it declares, using their titles and descriptions, for the owner to edit before publishing. Use when a site has no llms.txt or a weak one. For a corrected robots.txt use fix_robots; for a starter entitymap.json use fix_entitymap.
name: draft_llms
